CustomField.description: Set when the account (or one of its financial contacts) must be synced to the financial system; Batch_FinancialSystemAccountSync picks it up and clears it after a successful sync. Replaces FinancialSystemSync__c / FinancialSystemSyncBank__c / FinancialSystemSyncMandate__c.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The account is waiting to be synced to the financial system (Exact).
CustomField.label: Sync To Financial System
